answers.core: It feels natural for the feature to exist within the editor. The fact that it's missing feels more like a papercut than anything. I'm not sure the existing functionality can be modified with an add-on but I'm not familiar enough with the codebase to know for sure.
answers.workaround:
There are two ways to work arount hsi currently:
- Create these nested folders one by one in Godot (and wait for the scanning process to complete each time). This is very slow.
- Do it outside of Godot in file explorer.

Neither option is optimal.

title: Create Folder popup should support nested folders
